comment: Menu Bar widget (hidden menu bar items)
keys: Turn it on to keep menu bar items here instead of in the menu bar.
Hold ⌘ and drag menu bar items to the left of the ‹ separator to hide them here.
Show the separator, then hold ⌘ and drag menu bar items to its left.
Allow Screen Recording to see item images.
Allow Accessibility to click items from here.
Set to always show in the menu bar
Menu bar items to the left of this separator are hidden. Click to show or hide them; ⌘-drag items across it to choose which are hidden.
Show hidden items in the menu bar

DynamicNotch adds a separator (‹) to the menu bar. Items to its left are hidden from the menu bar and appear in the Menu Bar widget, where clicking one opens it. To choose which items are hidden, show the separator, then hold ⌘ and drag menu bar items across it.
Quit DynamicNotch or turn hiding off to bring every item back.
Add the Menu Bar widget to the Nook to use hiding.
Shows the hidden items as images. Without it, the widget lists their names.
Clicks an item for you and moves items. Without it, clicking an item shows the hidden items in the menu bar for a few seconds.
After allowing access in System Settings, you may need to quit and reopen DynamicNotch.
⌘-drags this item to the right of the separator (needs Accessibility).
Items of these apps are marked with a pin when they end up hidden. Move to Menu Bar puts them back to the right of the separator.
